scores.tell: Busy real-environment backdrop (buildings, hedge, path, grass, tree) is too detailed; real cards keep a few large quiet shapes. Bird feeder is central, though.
none. Flat purple wave backdrop, tone-on-tone and quiet, matches the real towel/whistle fields.

Soft blue gradient backdrop with a simple truss. Quiet and tidy. Slight extra glow rays only.
Beach scene with many props: starfish, shell, beach ball, palm, sea, clouds and a cow-logo cooler. Too many small items and too much whimsy for the real cards' restraint.
